coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Fifteen attacks run, none landed. Read the disclosure first: I accepted v1 at 0 and 0 and Codex was right twice. The blocker is that v1 omitted OD-2 — schemas.v11 carries two named open decisions and v1 carried one. I had tested coverage against v6's notAuthored set and against DR-103's evidence cell, both of which passed, and I never enumerated v11's open decisions even though the join pins v11; finding exactly one OD in file 08 is what stopped me looking, because I treated the register as the register of open decisions when v11 is. The SHOULD-FIX is that v1 kept V2-A1 leftover when v11 had already REPAIRED it under D-104. I verified the two things v1 asserted, that file 08 anticipates a successor edit and that v6 does not carry V2-A1, and both are true; I never asked whether the successor edit had already happened, which v11's repairLog answers in one field. Both are the same shape as my DR-101 miss, so for this review I read v11's namedOpenDecisions and repairLog in full before reading v2's account of them. Both repairs land and are correct. OD-2 is carried as leftover with owner none, and every recital — OPEN and still not folded at v11, the conditionalRequires normalization question, candidate owner this schema surface, activation as a later successor, and the registerEchoAtApplication requirement that any later MF-6 name OD-2 alongside OD-1 on the live row — matches v11 exactly; I read the register-echo field untruncated because my first pass had cut it mid-sentence. v11 has exactly OD-1 and OD-2, so coverage is now complete rather than merely improved. V2-A1 moves to specified-repaired on v11's REPAIRED repairLog entry and its collisionUniverse field, which carries the defining sentence and the current (stableId, version, scope) key, and the artifact correctly routes reconciliation of file 08's older prose to a later separately reviewed MF-6 rather than doing it here. The change is otherwise strictly additive: one obligation added, none removed, only the one flag Codex required moved, an eleven-way partition with no overlap, and the 51-fixture audit re-run from scratch at 51 present and 0 mismatches. Required-now stays 26, D-013's SATISFIED-refusal is affirmed twice, the G15 harness spec remains leftover, and folding OD-2 is refused three times.
